identity.model: PS4 Slim (inferred from seller text; model number not readable in photo)
read_from: photo 0 (PS logo; Slim/model number not readable)

claims.claim: Clean Sonny PS4 slim station with 8 to 10 games installed and one pad
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows the console top; no controller, no games list, and no evidence of installed games.
Photo 0 shows a PS4-style console but does not show the CUH model number or a clear Slim-specific identifier.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/version (Slim vs other) is not confirmed from the photo; pricing depends on version.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label showing the CUH model number (e.g., CUH-20xx/21xx/22xx) and a side/port view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 Slim/unknown PS4 version for the market until the CUH label is shown.

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, audio/video).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the console powering on to the home screen and playing a game (or showing the disc drive accepting a disc).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume issues until a working boot + display is shown.

risks.risk: Games claim (8–10 installed) not verifiable; could be fewer or require downloads.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo of the Games & Apps list showing the installed titles/count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no confirmed installed games) until the installed list is shown.

risks.risk: Controller inclusion not shown; could be missing or a non-original/defective pad.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the controller (front/back) and a video showing it pairing/working in-game.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no controller included until the pad is shown and tested.

risks.risk: Accessories/cables not shown (power cable, HDMI, charging cable).
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of all included items (power brick/cable, HDMI, controller cable if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle until all required cables are confirmed.

proof_requests: Photo of the console underside/label showing the CUH model number.
Video: power on to PS home screen with HDMI working (and ideally Wi‑Fi connected).
Screenshot/photo of the installed Games & Apps list showing the number of installed games (8–10).
Photo of the included controller (pad) and a short clip showing it working (buttons + pairing).
Photo of all included accessories laid out (power/HDMI/controller cable).
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s a PS4-style console, but it does not prove Slim version, controller inclusion, installed game count, or working condition—so a safe worst-case price can’t be set without the key identifiers and test proof.
